base_name_rule: base_name_he = the product's name without a colour, for the line in the cart, the checkout, the order and the invoice: base_name_he + ' · ' + the option labels (data/catalog/option-labels-he.json). A name without a colour keeps its name. Where the name carries something that is itself an option (a shape, a height, a heading, 'ציפית' next to a with-insert option, 'שלישייה' next to single prints), that part leaves the base too, so no option can contradict it. Where story.json option_names_he names an option (lumbar 30x50, with or without insert), that name is the base for that option. Products without options keep the base alone.

description_rule: description_he[card_id]: the product page's description (and the source of its meta description), over the one the build composes from the card's texture, materials and dimensions. 2-3 sentences, present tense, facts the card states only (what it is, materials, sizes, framing); never the card's notes, and no finish, glazing or frame material the card does not state. Hebrew only (the ת33 build check). Option-neutral: a sentence about one option names it ('בדגם ד׳: ...'). The first two sentences stand alone within 155 characters, for the meta description.

description_he.framed-art-cj-morandi-triptych-sage: שלושה הדפסים מופשטים במרקם מובלט על גב סיבית, כל אחד במסגרת שחורה דקה. חמישה דגמים בארבע מידות, מ-40×60 עד 70×90 ס"מ לכל הדפס. בדגם ד׳: קשת מרווה, משיכות מכחול בבז'-ורוד ובאפור וקו פחם דק במעגל, על רקע שמנת.
